title: Step 3 - a Bookmark type with JSON struct tags
intro: The rest of this track builds a bookmarks API.
It starts with the value it stores.
The text in backquotes after each field is a struct tag.
`encoding/json` reads it to name the field in JSON, so
Go's `URL` becomes `"url"`. Without the tag JSON would
use the Go name as is.
`omitempty` leaves a field out when it holds its zero
value, so a bookmark without a title has no `"title"`.
A `time.Time` encodes as an RFC 3339 string.
